issues.description: Method parameter mismatch for getTotalNumberOfStudents: the problem statement UML (Lecture class) declares a no-argument method getTotalNumberOfStudents(): int, but the solution implementation defines public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests). This changes the public API students are expected to implement and is used inconsistently inside the solution (e.g., getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor calls getTotalNumberOfStudents(true)). A student implementing the exercise according to the UML will implement a parameterless method and may be confused by the solution's boolean parameter version.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution match the problem statement UML by providing a public int getTotalNumberOfStudents() method (no parameters) that returns the intended total (inscribed + guest students). If a variant that optionally excludes guests is desired, add an overloaded method public int getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) or make the boolean variant a private helper and have the public no-arg method delegate to it. Alternatively, if the boolean parameter is intentional, update the problem statement and UML to declare getTotalNumberOfStudents(boolean includeGuests) and document its semantics.
